module: Debug and visual feedback drawing of the Easy Select tool in the 3D world (debugDrawer): boxes of discovered objects, of the candidate stack, of the chosen object, of selected or dragged objects, objects filtered out for being too large, selection axes (X red, Y green, Z blue) and maximum distance ring around the camera. The 2D debug drawing is delegated to the selectionScreenDebug module.

drawWorld.desc: Draws in the world the boxes and axes described by the selection snapshot and the options. Boxes are drawn as lines if options.outlineMode == 1 (otherwise filled).

snapshot.desc: Selection state: discovery, candidates, pick, filteredLarge, camera

options.desc: outlineMode, selectedIds, draggingIds, depthTest, dragDepthTest, selectedDepthTest, showFilteredLarge, debugEnabled, maxDiscoveryOutlines, maxStackOutlines, showSelectionAxes, axisLocal, axisLengthScale, axisLineWidth, showDistanceRing, maxDistance

drawScreen.desc: Delegates the 2D overlay debug to selectionScreenDebug.draw(snapshot, options).
